text_block_list.text: Agnes Tachyon managed to achieve brilliant results in the Twinkle Series.

Together, we made it through those
truly precious "first three years."

And so, one day while still basking in the afterglow
of that major milestone—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...Kukuku, hey now, Trainer-kun!
You seem quite lost in thought!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I've been here for five minutes already.
Your lack of situational awareness concerns me.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It's nothing serious.
I just came to extend a little invitation.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: On what you might call a "date."

And so, I ended up going on
a "date" with Agnes Tachyon.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It was recommended to me as reference reading.
'There's so much to see that you'll never run out of conversation topics,' they said.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Look, that tank is made of beautiful acrylic panels!
It truly is the savior of aquariums.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Back when we used tempered glass,
there were many challenges. Especially the processing—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
—No, that's not it. Fish? Yeah, they're fish.
Look, aren't they pretty? So colorful.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Alright, next up is shopping! A place this big
is bound to get your spending impulse going, right?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
How about it, Trainer-kun?
Is there anything you'd like to buy?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
That's a shame, there's nothing I want to buy either.
I'm the type who usually shops online anyway.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Alright! Let's move on to the next one!

—The "date" continued after that,
and before we knew it, evening had arrived.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Time really flies. So tell me,
now that the "date" is over, has anything changed?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
If you feel short of breath, chest pain,
dizziness, or anything unusual, be sure to report it to me at once.

The word "report" clicks in my mind.
Could it be――

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, of course it is!
Didn't you notice?
choice_data_list: There's no way I'd notice that!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
We've known each other for three years now.
There's no way I'd go on a meaningless date with you at this point!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I want to record your current emotions.
Sensory or intuitive words are fine, just tell me.

When Agnes Tachyon gets like this, it's hard to refuse her.
For now, I tried stringing together some safe-sounding words.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hmm, and then? Anything besides that?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Argh! No, wait, that's not it at all!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
No, more like, um...!
With heart-pounding excitement and romance, you know?!
choice_data_list: (L-Like butterflies in my stomach or fluttering hearts?!)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Phew... My apologies. I lost my composure for a moment.
I am not fond of research not going well.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
About the fundamental core of social animals, you see.
In the end, it all comes down to 'emotions.'

I feel like, sometime long ago,
she said something just like that—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
To tell you the truth, I've recently developed quite an interest
in the power generated by "enthusiasm" and "passion."

"Thinking back on it, she had shown an interest
in 'emotions' since quite a long time ago."

I thought it was just temporary,
but it seems that's not the case.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: ...Because I was made painfully aware of how poor of a thing imagination is.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I had always known that interference from
all sorts of things could affect one's running.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: However, it's ultimately just an interference effect. While it exerts a certain level of influence, it's not a decisive blow.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: That's what I had thought.

As if recalling that very scene,
she slowly closed her eyes.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: That day... the day of the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
After running through the finish line,
the fans' passionate cheers awaited.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Their cheers truly invigorated me throughout the race,
serving as a strong tailwind at my back.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
That is why I wanted to thank them from the bottom of my heart.
Looking up at them, I suddenly realized something—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
—The fact that I was able to produce results now.
No, the fact that I was able to reach beyond the Classics
on my own two feet in the first place.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Wasn't all of that
ultimately fueled by 'emotion'?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: "I began to wonder if perhaps I didn't truly understand the real power of 'emotions', you know?"
Agnes Tachyon slowly opened her eyes.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, choosing this path to avoid breakdowns
was also driven by your "emotions."
choice_data_list: (Come to think of it, that's right...!)

text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, there was a time when a casual remark from me
had a major impact on her decision.

Whether she can reach the "Umamusume's limits"
with her own legs, or not—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh, and here I thought 'emotions'
were the furthest thing from science...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Surprise upon surprise, two sides of the same coin!
One must never underestimate it!
Over these three years, "emotions" took Agnes Tachyon on a far wilder ride than she could have ever imagined—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"If we wish to reach even greater heights,
we have no choice but to analyze and unravel these 'emotions'!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Don't you agree,
my dear guinea pig-kun?

—And yet, she didn't seem
to mind it all that much.
choice_data_list: You're not quite what I expected...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hm? What is it? Now I'm curious.

Fascinated by the Umamusume physique, she overcame the fragility of her own legs,
stormed through the Senior Class—
and finally fulfilled her childhood dream.

"An uncompromising, experiment-loving problem child—
from another perspective, she's simply an earnest, hard worker."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Whoa now, of all the things you could say,
that's practically half an insult!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: That's the first time anyone's praised me like that! I've been called selfish and a stray more times than I can count, but this? Ahahaha!

It must have caught her completely off guard,
because she couldn't stop laughing for a while after that.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: ...*sigh* That gave me a good laugh.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Still, if that's the impression you've gathered after spending three years with me, it must not be far off.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Looking back, you've taken great care of me. Well... forgive me for the cliché, but—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I truly feel from the bottom of my heart that I'm glad you're my Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Um, it's a bit embarrassing to say this out of the blue... but you've been a tremendous help to me. Thank you.

A smile escapes my lips at the unexpected realization
that the day has actually come when Agnes Tachyon
offers a sincere, heartfelt thank-you.
choice_data_list: I'm so glad to have you as my trainee, too!
I'm so glad to have you as my trainee too!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. Thank you,
you truly are an exceptional—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
—Such an excellent guinea pig.
Hehehe...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Now, my dear guinea pig,
would you care to share your thoughts with me once more?

Clutched tightly in Agnes Tachyon's hands
were a heart rate monitor and a voice recorder...!

At any rate...
Beyond the potential of Umamusume—
Into even further uncharted territory.

Our days walking side by side with Agnes Tachyon
had begun once again.
